sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B: 9B Dense Open MIT Coding Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-9B is an MIT-licensed 9B dense model released 18 Aug 2026 for single-GPU and edge use. It scores 70.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 86.4 on GPQA Diamond.

sources.snippet: The Ornith-1.5 family includes a 9B dense model and a 9B-Mobile variant aimed at edge deployment, plus GGUF and MLX builds that target laptops and Apple silicon.
